hero.title: ArcGIS Urban
hero.subtitle: Smart city planning
hero.text: ArcGIS Urban is an immersive 3D experience designed to improve urban planning and decision-making. Quickly visualize projects in your local context and leverage location intelligence to drive better decisions. Be more proactive and less reactive in your planning process. Simplify project collaboration across internal agencies and public stakeholders.

blocks.title: Shaping future cities
blocks.text: ArcGIS Urban is an immersive 3D experience designed to drive smart urban planning and development.

items.title: Improve planning productivity
items.text: Streamline workflows and improve efficiency by focusing effort where it matters most.

items.title: Visualize projects citywide
items.text: Visualize plans and projects in an immersive 3D view to understand change at the city scale.

items.title: Communicate trends
items.text: Reveal insights about policies and initiatives to evaluate performance and support decisions.

items.title: Increase community engagement
items.text: Bring transparency to planning programs by sharing interactive content with the community.

items.title: 3D city model as context for change
items.text: Design a 3D representation of the city and gain contextual information to assess performance and support decision-making.

items.title: Zoning and land-use planning
items.text: Produce 3D visual and analytical representations of your legal zoning code and measure the immediate impact of your proposed design.

items.title: Urban design and project sharing
items.text: Quickly create detailed planning scenarios and share your work with stakeholders.

blocks.title: Urban Planning Excellence
blocks.text: Discover how cities worldwide are leveraging ArcGIS Urban to transform their planning processes and drive smart development decisions.

items.label: City and County of Honolulu
items.title: City and County of Honolulu
items.desc: Our planners' eyes got really wide when they realized that they could quickly and easily change values in the zoning code and see what the difference in development would be. — Ken Schmidt, GIS Administrator

items.label: San Francisco Planning Department
items.title: San Francisco Planning Department
items.desc: The core long-range planning challenge is how to design the city of tomorrow to provide a rich urban experience within the limits of infrastructural capacity. — Sr. Strategic Sustainability Planner-Economist, City of San Francisco

items.label: Boston Planning & Development Agency
items.title: Boston Planning & Development Agency
items.desc: We wanted to develop workflows that used metrics and a standardized process and procedure to evaluate projects moving forward. — Sr. Architect & Urban Designer, Boston Planning & Development Agency
